content: LangGraph PostgresSaver checkpoints are tied to a specific serialization format and thread_id column (varchar with length limit -- values should stay under 255 chars). There is no built-in cross-database migration API for checkpoints; moving conversation state between two independent Postgres instances requires manually reading the checkpoint tuple via getTuple() from the source saver and writing/reconstructing it against the destination saver -- this is an application-level ETL, not a supported operation. PostgresSaver also requires setup() per deployment/upgrade and does not auto-migrate its own schema across langgraph version bumps.
